entities.name: Ibulocydine
observations: Reported preclinical radiosensitizer in human lung and colon cancer cells; evidence derives from one primary study, PMID:25082098.

entities.name: PMID:25082098
observations: 2014 preclinical study reports ibulocydine plus radiotherapy reduced viability and clonogenic survival in human lung/colon cancer cells and delayed xenograft growth.

Combination-associated mitochondrial apoptosis evidence included loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, cytosolic cytochrome-c release, caspase activation, lower Bcl-2/Bax ratio, and BCL2 rescue effects.

entities.name: Ibulocydine radiosensitization
observations: A single preclinical study supports ibulocydine radiosensitization through mitochondria-mediated apoptosis; available evidence is abstract-only and no clinical validation was identified.
